Class Player

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsoft.mesos.server.model.game.player.Player
public class Player extends Object
Represents one participant in a match together with the mutable resources they own.

A player is identified by a nickname, owns a totem color, and tracks both food and prestige points. The player also references the Tribe that stores all collected cards and long-term bonuses accumulated during the game.

    • Player

      public Player(String nickname, int food, int prestigePoints, TotemColor totemColor)
      Creates a player with the provided identity, resources, and a fresh empty tribe.
      Parameters:
      nickname - player's nickname
      food - starting food amount
      prestigePoints - starting prestige points amount
      totemColor - totem color assigned to the player

    • Player

      public Player(String nickname, int food, int prestigePoints, TotemColor totemColor, Tribe tribe)
      Creates a player with the provided identity, resources, and tribe aggregate.

      This overload is used by tests and setup code that need to inject a pre-populated tribe. Passing null creates a fresh empty tribe so newly created players are immediately ready to collect cards.

      Parameters:
      nickname - player's nickname
      food - starting food amount
      prestigePoints - starting prestige points amount
      totemColor - totem color assigned to the player
      tribe - tribe aggregate owned by the player, or null to create a new one
